test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Succulent
solution: The correct answer is **'Juicy'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Succulent**' is '**Juicy**'. • **Succulent**: (used about fruit, vegetables, and meat) containing a lot of juice and tasting very good. [(फल, सब्ज़़ियाँ और गोश्‍त) रस से भरपूर और बहुत स्‍वादिष्‍ट; रसीला] • *Example: The meal ends with a **succulent** dessert and cocktails.* • **Juicy**: contains a lot of juice. (रस से भरा हुआ; रसदार, रसीला) • *Example: **juicy** oranges...* **Correct Answer:__** *Juicy.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Coarse**: consisting of large pieces; rough, not smooth. (मोटे ढेलों वाला; खुरदुरा) • **Foul**: that smells or tastes disgusting. (बदबूदार, ख़राब गंध या स्‍वाद वाला) • **Decent**: being of an acceptable standard; satisfactory. (शालीन; उचित, उपयुक्त) 163:Tc97, The correct answer is '**Breach**'.
